## Statement

Original wording (verbatim from the source):

```latex
$\eta(G) \le \chi(G)$, where $\eta(G)$ is the least $k$ admitting a labelling $\ell: V \to \{1..k\}$ whose neighbourhood sums differ on every edge.
```

Normalized:

For bipartite graphs: η(G) <= 2.

## Known results

- Every connected bipartite graph on at most 15 vertices has η <= 2. *(Caleshu, math-conjectures, Conjectures/AdditiveColouring; computational; reproduced: True)*
